Description: Start at center T. Sprint to each of 5 baseline balls, return each to center. Time per set.
Coaching Notes: Low center of gravity. Explosive push-off from outside foot. Change of direction is the key.

Description: 4 cones in cross pattern. Sprint to each, return to center each time. Alternate direction.
Coaching Notes: Start slow for pattern integrity. Add pace only after 3 clean sets.

Description: Cones in T shape. Sprint forward, shuffle left, shuffle right, backpedal. Timed.
Coaching Notes: Drive off outside foot on shuffles. Don't cross feet. Decelerate with control.

Description: Two cones 5m apart. Figure-eight pattern around cones. Fast lateral movements.
Coaching Notes: Maintain low stance throughout. Eyes up. Quick directional change at each cone.

Description: 6-8 cones in zigzag line. Sprint through as fast as possible. Plant and cut.
Coaching Notes: Short choppy steps approaching cone. Plant hard off outside foot. Stay low.

Description: Shuffle baseline to baseline. Coach calls direction change randomly.
Coaching Notes: Feet never cross. Stay in athletic stance. Quick reaction to direction cue.

Description: 5 cones in star shape. Sprint from center to each point and back. Timed.
Coaching Notes: Explosive acceleration from center each time. Controlled deceleration at cones.

Description: Two players face each other on service line. One leads, one mirrors lateral movement.
Coaching Notes: Small quick steps. Stay low. React immediately. No anticipating.

Description: Cones in straight line.11 Lateral shuffle through gaps. Progress to diagonal pattern.
Coaching Notes: Quick feet. Don't look down. Rhythm over speed to start.

Description: Coach drops reaction ball. Player reacts and catches before 2nd bounce.
Coaching Notes: Split step before ball drops. Stay on balls of feet. Full sprint effort.

Description: Partner tosses to random side. Player split steps then explodes to catch.
Coaching Notes: Cue exactly at ball contact — not before, not after. Land low, explode wide.

Description: Sprint baseline to service line. Max acceleration. Walk back recovery.
Coaching Notes: Drive knees. Pump arms. First 3 steps are everything. Full recovery between.

Description: Sprint from center mark to T and back. 10m max distance. Explosive.
Coaching Notes: Stay low off the start. Decelerate with control. Rest 30s between.

Description: Ladder on court. High knees through each square. Increase speed each set.
Coaching Notes: Quick ground contact. Drive knees up. Arms active. Eyes forward.

Description: Step in and out of each ladder square laterally. Progress to diagonal.
Coaching Notes: Precise foot placement first. Add speed once pattern is clean.

Description: Coach points direction. Player explodes 3-5 steps only. Reset.
Coaching Notes: React don't anticipate. First step is widest. Drive off back foot.

Description: Partner holds resistance band around waist. Sprint against resistance. Release.
Coaching Notes: Lean into band. Drive arms. Maintain form under resistance.

Description: Coach drops cone at random. Player sprints and picks up before rolling stops.
Coaching Notes: Stay in ready position. React immediately. Full acceleration every rep.

Description: Lateral crossover step through each ladder square. Both directions.
Coaching Notes: Cross lead foot over first. Quick placement. Rhythm before speed.

Description: Basic single bounce jump rope. Consistent rhythm. Light on feet.
Coaching Notes: Land on balls of feet. Soft knees. Small jumps. Wrists turn rope, not arms.

Description: Front foot forward, back foot on bench or floor. Lower rear knee toward ground.
Coaching Notes: Front shin vertical. Drive through front heel. Full range of motion. Control the descent.

Description: Hold med ball or dumbbell at chest. Squat deep, elbows inside knees at bottom.
Coaching Notes: Chest up. Heels down. Deep squat develops mobility and strength simultaneously.

Description: Partner or wall pass. Explosive push. Catch and absorb. Square stance.
Coaching Notes: Full hip extension at release. Catch with soft hands. Step into throw.

Description: Rotational wall throw or partner pass. Drive from hips. Both directions.
Coaching Notes: Rotation starts from hips — arms follow. Full hip extension at release.

Description: Raise med ball overhead. Slam to ground explosively. Full body extension.
Coaching Notes: Full extension on raise. Aggressive slam. Core braced throughout.

Description: Standing on one leg. Hinge at hip. Reach toward floor. Return to stand.
Coaching Notes: Slow eccentric — 3 count down. Spine neutral throughout. Slight knee bend on working leg.

Description: Step wide to side. Bend loading knee. Push-off back to start. Both directions.
Coaching Notes: Keep stepping foot flat. Loading knee tracks over toes. Chest up.

Description: Forearm plank. Straight line from head to heel. Core engaged. Breathe.
Coaching Notes: Don't let hips sag or pike. Squeeze glutes. Neutral neck. Progress to longer holds.

Description: Forearm side plank. Hip off ground. Straight body line. Both sides.
Coaching Notes: Stack feet or stagger for easier version. Don't let hip drop. Full duration.

Description: Lie on back, feet flat, knees bent. Drive hips up. Squeeze at top.
Coaching Notes: Posterior pelvic tilt at top. Squeeze glutes hard. Controlled descent.

Description: Band around ankles or knees. Athletic stance. Lateral steps maintaining tension.
Coaching Notes: Constant tension. Don't let feet come together. Small controlled steps.

Description: Standard push-up or regression (knees). Straight body line. Full range.
Coaching Notes: Elbows at 45° — not flared wide. Chest to floor. Controlled descent.

Description: Diagonal pattern — high to low, both directions. Drive from core and hips.
Coaching Notes: Rotation from core. Straight arms. Control the path. Both directions equal reps.

Description: Phantom serve motion focusing only on foot pattern. No ball. Trophy to follow-through.
Coaching Notes: Emphasize shoulder rotation before foot positioning completes. Back foot drives forward.

Description: Coach feeds. Player split steps at contact. Explodes to ball. Focus on timing only.
Coaching Notes: Split happens BEFORE coach contact. Land and react — don't wait.

Description: Crossover step to overhead position. Shoulder turn. Trophy position loading. No ball.
Coaching Notes: Shoulder rotation must happen before foot positioning is complete.

Description: Approach pattern from baseline to net. Split step at service line. Ready position.
Coaching Notes: Small steps into net. Split exactly at bounce line. Continental grip ready.

Description: Coach feeds to alternating sides. Player executes split, recovery step, unit turn.
Coaching Notes: Recovery step after every shot. Unit turn early. Weight into the court.

Description: Approach step pattern for backhand slice. Crossover, side-step, contact point.
Coaching Notes: Stay sideways through contact. Step through the ball. High to low swing path.

Description: Coach feeds deep, then drop shot. Player sprints forward, recovers back.
Coaching Notes: First step is a crossover. Sprint on toes. Recover with split step.

Description: Player serves, immediately recovers to center mark before next ball is fed.
Coaching Notes: Follow-through lands you forward. Drive to center. Split on second ball.

Description: Juggle two balls simultaneously. One in each hand. Eyes up. Consistent height.
Coaching Notes: Eyes up. Small controlled touches. Progress only when 20+ consecutive achieved.

Description: Single hand juggle. Dominant then non-dominant. Count consecutive touches.
Coaching Notes: Stay relaxed. Wrist work not arm. Consistent toss height is the key.

Description: Agility ladder footwork combined with ball catch from partner. Both at same time.
Coaching Notes: Feet pattern first until automatic. Then add ball. Eyes cannot be on the ladder.

Description: Two players. Leader moves and passes ball. Follower mirrors and catches.
Coaching Notes: Stay in sync. Small steps. Anticipate movement pattern.

Description: Dribble tennis ball on racket strings while walking, then jogging.
Coaching Notes: Consistent contact point. Soft hands. Eyes up once pattern is comfortable.

Description: Partner drops reaction ball from chest. Player catches with one hand.
Coaching Notes: Stay on toes. React don't anticipate. Alternate catching hand.

Description: Player performs lateral shuffle. Simultaneously tosses and catches ball overhead.
Coaching Notes: Feet independent of hands. Don't let ball pattern disrupt footwork rhythm.

Description: Varied jump rope patterns: single, double under attempts, lateral side-to-side.
Coaching Notes: Master single bounce first. Build rhythm before attempting variations.

Description: 90-90 transitions, deep lunge with rotation, pigeon variations, hip flexor release.
Coaching Notes: Move slowly through each transition. Breathe into restriction. Never force range.

Description: Leg swings, arm circles, hip circles, walking lunges, inchworms, high knees.
Coaching Notes: Controlled movement throughout. No bouncing. Increase ROM progressively.

Description: Kneeling lunge. Drive hips forward. Reach arm opposite to back leg overhead.
Coaching Notes: Square the hips first. Drive forward through hip crease. Breathe out into it.

Description: Seated or quadruped thoracic rotation. Thread needle variation. Both directions.
Coaching Notes: Initiate from mid-back not shoulder. Keep hips stable. Slow controlled rotation.

Description: Calf raises, ankle circles, wall ankle mobilization, toe raises.
Coaching Notes: Critical for change of direction. Slow ankle circles. Full range each direction.

Description: Standing hamstring stretch, seated reach, lying single leg reach. Both sides.
Coaching Notes: Soft knee bend. Hinge from hip not spine. Feel stretch in belly of muscle.

Description: Arm circles, cross-body stretch, sleeper stretch, wall pec stretch.
Coaching Notes: Critical for serve health. Sleeper stretch for posterior capsule. Slow pace.

Description: Boat pose, bird-dog, dead bug, plank variations. Core through stability.
Coaching Notes: Breath is the foundation. Move on exhale. Hold positions, don't rush transitions.

Description: Pigeon pose both sides. Walk hands forward for deeper release. Breathe.
Coaching Notes: Never force this position. Use a block or folded towel under hip if needed.

Description: Walk hands out to plank, reach one arm up with rotation, walk back. Both sides.
Coaching Notes: Slow and deliberate. Full rotation at the top. Straight-leg hamstring stretch.

Description: IT band, quads, hamstrings, calves, thoracic spine. 30-60s per area.
Coaching Notes: Slow controlled rolling. Pause on tender areas. Breathe through discomfort.

Description: Post-session static stretches. Major muscle groups. Hold 30-45s each.
Coaching Notes: Only after full warm-up or post-session. Never cold static stretch.

Description: Box breathing or 4-7-8 pattern. Lying down. Eyes closed. HRV recovery.
Coaching Notes: 4 count in, 7 count hold, 8 count out. Progressively slower. Nervous system down-reg.

Description: Stand on lacrosse ball. Roll full foot. Apply pressure to tender areas.
Coaching Notes: Standing weight load is pressure. Find tight spots and hold 30s.

Description: Easy 8-minute jog. Heart rate below 140. Conversational pace.
Coaching Notes: This is recovery — not conditioning. Do not push the pace. Belly breathing.

Description: Forward, backward, lateral skipping. Arms active. Light and rhythmic.
Coaching Notes: Easy pace. Warm tissue, not condition. Smile — set the tone.

Description: Alternate driving knees to hip height. Arms pump. On balls of feet.
Coaching Notes: Knee to hip height minimum. Pump arms opposite to legs. Light ground contact.

Description: Heel drives back to glute while jogging forward. Quick turnover.
Coaching Notes: Quick ground contact. Stay on toes. Upright posture throughout.

Description: Lateral movement with crossover step. Both directions. Hips rotate.
Coaching Notes: Hip rotation is the key movement. Stay low. Increase speed progressively.

Description: Forward/backward circles, cross-body swings, up-down swings. Both arms.
Coaching Notes: Full range of motion. Controlled. Gradually increase amplitude.

Description: Lunge forward with each step. Tall torso. Back knee nearly touches floor.
Coaching Notes: Step long enough for 90° front knee. Torso upright. Drive through front heel.
